name: kitsuden-site-video
description: Remotion source for the landing page's tutorial film and social image (site/).

scripts.render:tutorial: remotion render src/index.ts Tutorial out/tutorial-1080.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 && ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/tutorial-1080.mp4 -vf scale=1280:720:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 27 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -an ../site/media/tutorial.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -v error -ss 49.6 -i out/tutorial-1080.mp4 -frames:v 1 -vf scale=1280:720 -q:v 4 ../site/media/tutorial.jpg
scripts.render: npm run render:vtt && npm run render:tutorial && npm run render:og && npm run render:repo
